policy.name: shattered_crown_echo 120-card equipment roll policy
policy.source: STEP4 approved 120 cards + 108 legacy equipment templates

main_weapon.fixed: one complete SC pair, randomly chosen from 7-8 available SC attributes
main_weapon.random: one additional complete attribute x same-weapon pair, SC preferential weighting 7 / NN 3, other attr
main_weapon.rarity: all 4 same weapon; no cross weapon rolled on weapon slot
main_weapon.random_slots_individual_forge_reroll: allowed; may break secondary pair, never mandatory fixed core

non_weapon.fixed: 2 role-focused cards minted at drop; affinity attribute and weapon preferred, never hard-locked
non_weapon.random: 82% same-affinity-weapon pair package (SC favoured); otherwise independent 2 slots with partner completion/cycle bias
non_weapon.cross_rule: Common no random cross; Rare+ <=1 random cross, only strict NEUTRAL 30-card subset; fixed support may be off affinity

policy.equipment_attribute: One rolled main attribute. Main Weapon random2 may have one different secondary attribute (mono cards only). Nonweapon fixed may relax attribute for required support roles.
policy.drop_context: optional current Main Weapon weapon/attribute/core2 bias when nonweapon LOOT is minted; immutable afterward, no guaranteed pair duplicates; missing context uses unbiased generation.
policy.persistence: equipment individual stores exact fixed2 and random2, seed, weapon affinity, rolled attribute, random reroll counts. Equip/switch does not change cards.
policy.forge: each random slot reroll up to 3 attempts; present 2 new candidates (or keep). Paid attempt consumed even if keep; leave other slots and fixed SC unaltered.
policy.offhand_migration: 4 Talisman rarity variants -> 4 Scabbard variants; total Offhand variants remains 20; total equipment variants remains 108.
disabled_legacy_special_effects: W03: single-slot same-attribute override conflicts with paired random roll
A04: draw-pile Retain semantic undefined in current battle core
